summary: Celularity Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing receipt, on September 11, 2026, of Nasdaq Listing Qualifications Staff notifications confirming regained compliance with the minimum bid price rule (5550(a)(2)) and minimum market value of listed securities rule (5550(b)(2)); Nasdaq closed those matters. The previously disclosed deficiency under Rule 5250(c)(1), tied to delayed periodic reports, remains outstanding, and the company states it continues working to complete delayed filings. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation transaction is present; this is a routine listing-compliance update. Watch the pending periodic filings and any future delisting notice.
